import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

print(Path("summary.txt").read_text())
table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
print(table.to_string(index=False))
path = Path("chart.py")
source = path.read_text()
source = source.replace("plt.plot(region_data['Year'], region_data['Population Growth (%)'],",
                        "plt.plot(region_data['Year'], region_data['Urbanization Rate (%)'],")
source = source.replace("plt.title('Population Growth Trends by Region (1970-1995)'",
                        "plt.title('Urbanization Rate Trends by Region (1970-1995)'")
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec"))
ax = plt.gca()
print("TITLE:", ax.get_title())
print("YLABEL:", ax.get_ylabel())
print("YLIM:", ax.get_ylim())
print("LEGEND:", ax.get_legend_handles_labels()[1])
for line in ax.lines:
    rows = table[table["Region"] == line.get_label()]
    assert list(line.get_xdata()) == rows["Year"].tolist()
    assert list(line.get_ydata()) == rows["Urbanization Rate (%)"].tolist()
    print(line.get_label(), line.get_color(), list(line.get_ydata()))
